title: pneumonanthe ochroleuca
intro: Pneumonanthe ochroleuca, commonly known as Marsh Marigold, is a perennial herbaceous flowering plant in the buttercup family (Ranunculaceae). It has been used in traditional medicine to treat various health issues due to its health benefits, including anti-inflammatory and antiseptic properties, which can help alleviate respiratory problems and wounds. The therapeutic actions of Marsh Marigold include its ability to act as a diuretic, antispasmodic, and expectorant, making it useful in treating conditions such as bronchitis and coughs. The bioactive constituents of Marsh Marigold include alkaloids, glycosides, and saponins, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
